title: Ship slice 1: release, change set, dry run and first real run
description:
1. Merge to develop, then main after green (merge-to-develop-fix-there); release.
2. Build and upload the router zip; create a papyrus-monitoring change set (code + RouterIdeaPolicy fields); Ryan reads and executes it.
3. Dry run on Anth.us: papyrus ideas monitor-stories --dry-run; must show >= 1 pack. Paste pack signals in the ticket.
4. Invoke monitor-stories for hn and web-distinctive; read the per-site log lines; report ideas filed / refused, Jev lane used (generated.check.judgment), cost.
Acceptance: ideas filed on at least Anth.us, each citing >= 2 References, all in the Idea stage.
